location_qualifier: Taivu / Tasimboko coast; first echelons of 29 August–11 September landings
composing_text: The 124th Infantry was the nucleus of the force (Miller, chapter V).
source_locator: R2225: ch. V (echelons arrived 29 August–11 September)
current_activity: beginning of the Kawaguchi Force landings
notes: Miller, chapter V: the Kawaguchi Force echelons arrived at Guadalcanal between 29 August and 11 September 1942 and landed at night from destroyer-transports and transports. The claim date is the first day of that window, not a single-ship landing log. Confidence 0.5 (Miller, from US intelligence summaries and related US official compilations, not a 17th Army Operations footnote on this sentence).

notes: Miller, ch. X: Oka's Gifu force, already identified as including the 124th Infantry of this brigade, launched six counterattacks against Hill 27 on the afternoon of 2 January 1943. Confidence 0.5: Miller only.

source_locator: R2225: ch. XII, Reduction of the Gifu

notes: Miller, ch. XII: on 23 January 1943 the Gifu, held since mid-December by Oka's force of this brigade and attached 228th battalions, was cleared and the garrison almost completely wiped out. Confidence 0.5: Miller only.
